dataset: option40 - Alternative IV skew transformations + Put-Call Greek differentials
hypothesis: Short-term IV skew (10d/20d) might have lower prod_corr. IV skew momentum/z-score might decorrelate. Put-Call Greek differentials are fundamentally different signals.

key_findings: IV skew 20d (MPLJn9lL) PASSES ALL RA: sh1.94/fit1.6/subU1.25/2Y1.92 - but prod_corr=0.7896 > 0.7 FAIL
IV skew 10d (0mM1Lnk8) nearly passes: 2Y=1.57 vs 1.58 threshold (0.01 short!)
IV skew momentum (ts_delta) WEAK: sh1.24 - changes in skew have less predictive power than levels
IV skew z-scored DEAD: sh0.72 - temporal normalization kills signal
Put-Call theta diff (A17o5qJX) PROMISING: sh1.59 PASSES, fit1.02 PASSES, subU0.9 PASSES, but 2Y1.08 FAILS
Put-Call delta diff has REVERSED signal: sh=-1.37, flipping gives sh=1.37 (below 1.58 but worth tuning)
Put-Call gamma diff WEAK: sh1.34, needs tuning
analysis.conclusion: IV skew prod_corr has U-shaped relationship with tenor: short (20d=0.79) and long (1080d=0.76) are higher, medium (360d=0.75) is lowest. But ALL exceed 0.7. IV skew is fundamentally correlated with production alphas. Put-Call theta differential is the most promising alternative signal - passes Sharpe/fitness/subU but needs 2Y improvement. Next: b101 tests theta diff at different tenors + delta/gamma diff variants.
